Class I2c

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.i2c.I2c
public final class I2c extends Object
Register access to an I2C peripheral on the board's primary I2C bus (Wire, the SDA/SCL pins), recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno and backed by the core-bundled Wire library. It is the transport under sensors such as NineAxisMotionShield. Addresses are the 7-bit device addresses.
